evidenceKind: primary DXF schema review, current open-source documentation/changelog/source review, and local implementation/test-owner audit

observations.ordering: Common entity tables explicitly warn not to depend on their display order and recommend code-keyed dispatch. This does not authorize global tag sorting: nested framing, declared counts, same-code occurrence order, and entity-specific scopes still govern meaning.
observations.mline: The three vector families are repeated per vertex; 74/41 and 75/42 are count-framed nested lists; group-2 style names are redundant with the 340 style object reference.
observations.spline: Knot values and control/fit points have separate repeated arrays; group-41 weights are present only when the weights are non-unit as specified.
observations.nurbsurface: The published SURFACE DXF page supplies common modeler-data and isoline fields but no repeated CV grid. The ObjectARX API's in-memory control-point array is not a DXF wire sequence.

sources.limitation: DXF schema pages do not establish DWG byte layouts, CAD rendering, or ACIS semantics.

confirmedAndFixed.entity: MLINE repeated vectors and nested parameters
confirmedAndFixed.failureShape: A rooted MLINESTYLE ASCII profile with Y/Z-before-X position components was rejected by the old parser.
confirmedAndFixed.correction: Independent bounded ordinals for all nine vector component codes; separate bounded segment/fill cursors; early parameter blocks attach when the declared group-73 element count arrives.

confirmedAndFixed.failureShape: Generated ASCII and Binary context controls grouped repeated Y/Z vertex arrays before X inside one LEADER_LINE scope; the old parser discarded those components because it opened points only on group 10.
confirmedAndFixed.correction: Per-component bounded occurrence ordinals scoped to the current LEADER_LINE; group-305 closure checks X slot count and rejects Y/Z overflow.
